Here's what the filenames (variables field in the json) look like at the end of running my gitlog_to_hdsmj() versus the DV8 gitlog hdsm json. | gitlog_to_hdsmj | DV8 hdsm | | - | - | | ".gitignore" | ".gitignore" | |".gititgnore" | ".gititgnore" | | "QtNotepad/QtNotepad.pro"| "QtNotepad/QtNotepad.pro" | |"QtNotepad/main.cpp" | "QtNotepad/main.cpp" | | "QtNotepad/mainwindow.cpp" | "QtNotepad/mainwindow.cpp" | | "QtNotepad/mainwindow.h" | "QtNotepad/mainwindow.h" | | "QtNotepad/mainwindow.ui" | "QtNotepad/mainwindow.ui" | | "QtNotepad/resources.qrc" | "QtNotepad/resources.qrc" | | "README.md" | "README.md" | | - | LICENSE | | - | LICENSE.md | ## So the LICENSE and LICENSE.md files end up missing by the end of my gitlog_to_hdsmj(). ### How does LICENSE.md go missing? - parse_gitlog() I found that the LICENSE.md file goes missing in the parse_gitlog() function. In particular, on this line https://github.com/sailuh/kaiaulu/blob/851097eed2462c437535379fd82d71a101ecf771/R/parser.R#L67-L74 we are only getting the columns called data.files.file, data.files.added, and data.files.removed. However, if we print the perceval_parsed before setting perceval_parsed to this line, we see that the file "LICENSE.md" is in a different column called "data.files.newfile". So since the "newfile" column isn't accounted for in parse_gitlog, this results in the LICENSE.md missing from the parsed_gitlog table.

### How does LICENSE go missing? - bipartite_graph_projection()

To see how LICENSE went missing, I next ran the code
```r
transform_gitlog_to_bipartite_network(gitlog_table, mode ="commit-file")
# To check the files
unique(gitlog_graph$edgelist$to)
```

The LICENSE file was still in the table, so I moved on to the next step.

```r
gitlog_graph_proj <- bipartite_graph_projection(gitlog_graph, mode = FALSE, is_intermediate_projection = FALSE)
# To check the files
unique(c(gitlog_graph_proj[[2]]$from, gitlog_graph_proj[[2]]$to))
```

When I looked at my gitlog_graph_proj, I noticed the LICENSE file is missing. I took a closer look at the bipartite_graph_function and this is the line where it seems the LICENSE file disappears.

https://github.com/sailuh/kaiaulu/blob/851097eed2462c437535379fd82d71a101ecf771/R/graph.R#L106-L108

Thanks.

I am posting there since it will likely get lost in the discussion on the Pull Request changes. Let's leave this for revision 2 of this PR. For now, feel free to proceed as two separate functions if it is easier. 

You may remember I moved both the functions `dependencies_to_sdsmj` and `gitlog_to_hdsmj` to you for having a lot of overlap functionality. This revision request reflects why I asked so. Both the functions:

`dependencies_to_sdsmj()` and the function `gitlog_to_hdsmj()` are fundamentally using the code logic being discussed here: 

https://github.com/sailuh/kaiaulu/pull/171/files#r1167230670

They both take as input a graph (node + edgelist tables), and write that in a json format compatible to DV8. 

(p.s.: Note the graph format for parse_dependencies() will be added in a follow-up commit in order to address the issue mentioned in https://github.com/sailuh/kaiaulu/issues/189#issuecomment-1509292321). 

Therefore, your two functions should instead be a set of 3 functions. The code you wrote for parse_hdsmj() after suggested changes https://github.com/sailuh/kaiaulu/pull/171/files#r1167230670 should instead be generalized into a function:

`graph_to_dsmj()` and reside in R/graph.R. Said function would expect a variable `graph`, which is a list of two elements, nodes and edgelist (as you have observed in your `parse_hdsmj`). This function assumes the node table to be of the form:

| name | ... |
|--------|--------|
| value | ... | 

Where the "..." is any other number of columns the graph may have. For your function, these columns are ignored, since neither Depends nor DV8 does not annotate any information to the nodes other than their names (aka "variables" field). 

Meanwhile, the edgelist is of the form:

| from | to | \<weight1> | \<weight2> | ... | \<weighn>|
|--------|--------|--------|--------| --------|--------|
| Value | Value | Value |Value |... |Value |

Where weights1 through n is an arbitrary number of columns, where each represents a different weight to the edges. In Depends and DV8, these weights are the various dependency types a user may choose to include on Depends. 

Observe the following examples from both Gitlog and Dependencies in json for cells / edgelist:

```json
  "cells" : [ {
    "src" : 0,
    "dest" : 3,
    "values" : {
      "Cochange" : 1.0
    }
  }, {
    "src" : 1,
    "dest" : 2,
    "values" : {
      "Cochange" : 1.0
    }
```

```json
}, {
    "src" : 0,
    "dest" : 23,
    "values" : {
      "Use" : 3.0,
      "Import" : 1.0
    }
  }, {
    "src" : 0,
    "dest" : 1337,
    "values" : {
      "Import" : 1.0,
      "Call" : 1.0,
      "Create" : 1.0
    }
  }
```

As you can see, the format is the same, what changes is the columns the edgelist table has, which subsequently affects the fields that should be included under the cells "values" for every entry. If either the column doesn't exist on edgelist, or if that particular row of edgelist has value 0 for it, then it is not included.

This logic can be consistently captured in this generic `graph_to_dsmj()` function, and then reused for your functions `dependencies_to_sdsmj()` and `gitlog_to_hdsmj()`. 

Both these functions task is now only to rename the nodes and edgelist accordingly to names, from, to, etc, and then defer to `graph_to_dsmj()` the transformation. As such, these functions should reside in `R/network.R` alongside the transform functions, as you see that similar logic it is already implemented there:

https://github.com/sailuh/kaiaulu/blob/6d407d629a2646b3bd00d45e483447b1db7b7c01/R/network.R#L26-L41

At which point, it would make sense to rename them accordingly for consistency to:

`transform_dependencies_to_sdsmj()` and `transform_gitlog_to_hdsmj()`

Let me know if this makes sense. The code logic is fundamentally the same, other than we don't assume the column names on the Dependencies or Gitlog tables, but instead assume any remaining tables listed should be translated as Cell values in the json format.
